Tsugumi

Run the analysis you sketched with AI, as it is, and check it with your own hands.

Tsugumi is a research workbench in which the specification a person draws, the thing an AI edits and the processing that actually runs are one and the same Workflow. It runs on macOS, Linux and Windows (Windows through WSL2). You draw a computation or a data pipeline as Cards and the wires between them, implement it together with an AI, and run it in environments pinned with Nix. You open the code or the result of a Card you are curious about, change a condition and try again with the inputs that were saved. Going back and forth like this, a researcher comes to understand how the analysis got where it did, and can ask the next question.

Download for Mac See the demos without installing

Runs on macOS, Linux and Windows (Windows through WSL2. The app needs Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later) · Installation and development builds
